title: AI Efficiency and Deployment

hero.headline: Lower the cost and risk of production AI.
hero.description: Evaluation, latency analysis, and deployment support for teams running AI systems in production.

problem: Many AI systems are expensive to run and difficult to stabilize once they move beyond demos.
solution: Measure bottlenecks, optimize serving behavior, and support deployment decisions with real operational evidence.
proofNotes: This product should be backed by concrete performance metrics and reproducible evaluation methods.
